classification: historical measured evidence plus explicitly conditional algebra; no new APK or engine execution

measurement_scope.E: verify_audits.worker timer after its initial fetch_sample, through analyze.main, surface/evidence validation, final APK digest and evidence serialization; sampler.stop and metrics.json write occur after E
measurement_scope.A: worker elapsed through analyze.main and summary identity/completeness checks; includes surface for native but excludes the later separate legacy surface
measurement_scope.N: native_audit.run timer after its first APK hash through session open, Rules.run, class count, optional surface/resource fingerprints, session close, final APK hash and binary status verification
measurement_scope.prepare: NativeSession entry: binary verify, archive inventory, subprocess/reader creation, first dex_files query, inventory comparison; later lazy decoding is not ruled out
measurement_scope.structural: Rules.run plus complete FEATURE-set validation, including native SQL, CLI shape/hex transport and Python rule/graph logic
measurement_scope.surface: native_surface.scan plus resource_fingerprints: SQL, transport, Python grouping, DEX-byte reread/fingerprints and resource hashing
measurement_scope.R: E - N, a measured difference covering repeated input metadata/hash setup, TSV/report handling, Python intake/home subprocesses and outer verification; not a separately measured pure gate time
